Believed to be the largest in the world and also known as the "Ministers Treehouse" as the owner/builder Horace Burgess was an ordained minister who actually performed 23 weddings inside. Taking almost ten years to complete, construction began in 1993 and built around seven existing trees using mostly a chainsaw. Sadly it was destroyed by fire in 2019 and the photo credit is Chuck Sutherland.

Sadly it was destroyed by fire in 2019 and the photo credit is Chuck Sutherland.

# World's Largest Treehouse Burns Down in Tennessee
By [Bobbie Jean Sawyer](https://www.wideopencountry.com/author/bobbie-jean-sawyer/) | October 23, 2019
[](https://www.wideopencountry.com/crossville-treehouse-fire/#comments)[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wideopencountry.com%2Fcrossville-treehouse-fire%2F)[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wideopencountry.com%2Fcrossville-treehouse-fire%2F)[](mailto:?subject=World's%20Largest%20Treehouse%20Burns%20Down%20in%20Tennessee&body=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wideopencountry.com%2Fcrossville-treehouse-fire%2F)
Crossville, Tennessee's Minister's Tree House, believed to be the world's largest treehouse, burned down late Tuesday night (Oct. 22). **[WVLT News](https://www.wvlt.tv/content/news/Crews-respond-to-fire-at-Crossville-Treehouse-563682171.html)** in Knoxville, Tenn. reports that the entire building burned to the ground in just 15 minutes after the fire started around 11:30 p.m. ET. No injuries were reported.

The Minister's Treehouse, which stood nearly 100 feet tall, was a popular roadside tourist attraction and a beloved landmark among locals. Minister and landscaper Horace Burgess built the tree house with wood scraps and recycled metal over the course of 18 years,according to the **[_Knoxville News Sentinel_](https://www.knoxnews.com/story/news/2019/10/23/giant-crossville-treehouse-inspired-god-destroyed-fire/4069314002)**. Burgess said God**[spoke to him](https://www.knoxnews.com/story/news/2019/10/23/giant-crossville-treehouse-inspired-god-destroyed-fire/4069314002)** and told him to build the tree house.
I turned my life over to God," Burgess told the tourism website **[_Roadside America_](https://www.roadsideamerica.com/story/13769)**. "And the spirit of God said, 'If you build Me a tree house, I'll never let you run out of material.'"

# World's Largest Treehouse Burns Down in Tennessee
## Videos by Wide Open Country
The tree house was **[closed to the public](https://www.knoxnews.com/story/news/2019/10/23/giant-crossville-treehouse-inspired-god-destroyed-fire/4069314002)** in 2012 after the Tennessee Fire Marshal's office deemed it a public safety hazard.
**[CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/worlds-largest-treehouse-burns-to-the-ground-in-tennessee)** reports that the investigation into the cause of the fire is ongoing.
